items.toString: This issue links to "ops4j/org.ops4j.pax.web#2010 – [8.0.x] SSL requests hang when over 16kB (Web Link)"

items.fromString:
To reproduce:
- Enable ssl on Fuse 7.13
- Install the camel-servlet feature 
- Deploy this blueprint
{code:java}
<blueprint xmlns="http://www.osgi.org/xmlns/blueprint/v1.0.0"
           xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
           xsi:schemaLocation="
      http://www.osgi.org/xmlns/blueprint/v1.0.0 https://www.osgi.org/xmlns/blueprint/v1.0.0/blueprint.xsd
      http://camel.apache.org/schema/blueprint http://camel.apache.org/schema/blueprint/camel-blueprint.xsd">

    <camelContext xmlns="http://camel.apache.org/schema/blueprint">
        <route>
            <from uri="servlet:test"/>
            <setBody>
                <constant>Success</constant>
            </setBody>
            <log message="${body}"/>
        </route>

    </camelContext>

    <reference id="httpService" interface="org.osgi.service.http.HttpService"/>

    <bean class="org.apache.camel.component.servlet.osgi.OsgiServletRegisterer"
          init-method="register"
          destroy-method="unregister">
        <property name="alias" value="/camel"/>
        <property name="httpService" ref="httpService"/>
        <property name="servlet" ref="camelServlet"/>
    </bean>

    <bean id="camelServlet" class="org.apache.camel.component.servlet.CamelHttpTransportServlet"/>
</blueprint>
{code}

- Test with a 16 KB payload

{code:java}
user@user:/tmp$ curl -X POST https://localhost:8443/camel/test    --data-binary @payload.txt      --tlsv1.2      --insecure

..After 1 minute...

curl: (56) Recv failure: Connection reset by peer
{code}

- This bug was reproduced on Fuse 7.13.1 but it worked fine in 7.11.1. Version 7.12 also has this issue.

In Openshift > Operatorhub, try to install Fuse operator 7.11.x 

fuse-console                                  7.11.x                     fuse-console.v7.11.1           
fuse-console                                  7.11.x                     fuse-console.v7.11.1-0.1669922044.p 
fuse-console                                  7.11.x                     fuse-console.v7.11.1-0.1675972857.p 
fuse-console                                  7.11.x                     fuse-console.v7.11.1-0.1681224695.p   

There are 4 images to select, but if you use this subscription yaml, no installplans is being created. 

```

apiVersion: operators.coreos.com/v1alpha1
kind: Subscription
metadata:
  name: fuse-console
  namespace: amq7
spec:
  channel: 7.11.x
  installPlanApproval: Manual
  name: fuse-console
  source: redhat-operators
  sourceNamespace: openshift-marketplace
  startingCSV: fuse-console.v7.11.1-0.1681224695.p

``` 

or 

 

```apiVersion: operators.coreos.com/v1alpha1
kind: Subscription
metadata:
  name: fuse-console
  namespace: amq7
spec:
  channel: 7.11.x
  installPlanApproval: Manual
  name: fuse-console
  source: redhat-operators
  sourceNamespace: openshift-marketplace

```
items.toString:
In Openshift > Operatorhub, try to install Fuse operator 7.11.x 

fuse-console                                  7.11.x                     fuse-console.v7.11.1           
fuse-console                                  7.11.x                     fuse-console.v7.11.1-0.1669922044.p 
fuse-console                                  7.11.x                     fuse-console.v7.11.1-0.1675972857.p 
fuse-console                                  7.11.x                     fuse-console.v7.11.1-0.1681224695.p   

There are 4 images to select, but if you use this subscription yaml, no installplan is being created. 

 
{code:java}
apiVersion: operators.coreos.com/v1alpha1
kind: Subscription
metadata:
  name: fuse-console
  namespace: amq7
spec:
  channel: 7.11.x
  installPlanApproval: Manual
  name: fuse-console
  source: redhat-operators
  sourceNamespace: openshift-marketplace
  startingCSV: fuse-console.v7.11.1-0.1681224695.p{code}
or 

 
{code:java}
apiVersion: operators.coreos.com/v1alpha1
kind: Subscription
metadata:
  name: fuse-console
  namespace: amq7
spec:
  channel: 7.11.x
  installPlanApproval: Manual
  name: fuse-console
  source: redhat-operators
  sourceNamespace: openshift-marketplace
 
{code}
 

If the startingCSV is set to fuse-console.v7.11.1, fuse-console.v7.11.1-0.1669922044.p, or fuse-console.v7.11.1-0.1675972857.p, the install work but it never upgrade to fuse-console.v7.11.1-0.1681224695.p.

In Openshift > Operatorhub, try to install Fuse operator 7.11.x 

fuse-console                                  7.11.x                     fuse-console.v7.11.1           
fuse-console                                  7.11.x                     fuse-console.v7.11.1-0.1669922044.p 
fuse-console                                  7.11.x                     fuse-console.v7.11.1-0.1675972857.p 
fuse-console                                  7.11.x                     fuse-console.v7.11.1-0.1681224695.p   

There are 4 images to select, but if you use this subscription yaml, no installplans is being created. 

```

apiVersion: operators.coreos.com/v1alpha1
kind: Subscription
metadata:
  name: fuse-console
  namespace: amq7
spec:
  channel: 7.11.x
  installPlanApproval: Manual
  name: fuse-console
  source: redhat-operators
  sourceNamespace: openshift-marketplace
  startingCSV: fuse-console.v7.11.1-0.1681224695.p

``` 

or 

 

```apiVersion: operators.coreos.com/v1alpha1
kind: Subscription
metadata:
  name: fuse-console
  namespace: amq7
spec:
  channel: 7.11.x
  installPlanApproval: Manual
  name: fuse-console
  source: redhat-operators
  sourceNamespace: openshift-marketplace

```

items.fromString:
One the camel-smpp hits the following error:

[org.jsmpp.session.SMPPSession.connectAndBind] [Thread-3] [ERROR] [transactionId:] [integrationId:] [routeId:] - Receive negative bind response
org.jsmpp.extra.NegativeResponseException: Negative response 0000000d (Bind Failed) found

The camel-smpp try to reconnect however it does not work.
The only workaround is to restart the entire route.
items.toString:
Once the camel-smpp endpoint hits the following error:

{code}
[org.jsmpp.session.SMPPSession.connectAndBind] [Thread-3] [ERROR] [transactionId:] [integrationId:] [routeId:] - Receive negative bind response
org.jsmpp.extra.NegativeResponseException: Negative response 0000000d (Bind Failed) found
{code}

The camel-smpp try to reconnect however it does not work.
The only workaround is to restart the entire route.
